title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17776v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Thomson problem asks for N unit charges on a sphere with minimum Coulomb energy; for large N the best configurations known are curated in the Cambridge Cluster Database, whose largest-N entries were set in October 2026. We report configurations for N = 912, 1382 and 2502 with energies 0.0036186, 0.0109730 and 0.0614033 below the database values, certified by exact integer arithmetic. All three are numerically strict local minima modulo rotations and keep the defect inventory and scar compositions of the database configurations; the database value for N = 912 had been reached by two different methods. Our search runs unconstrained replica-exchange basin hopping from the database configurations, with a shared pool of minima, recombination of improved regions after relabelling by geometry, and gradient-only polishing; replica-exchange basin hopping alone found the N = 912 and 1382 configurations, the former in one of five runs. translated_title: 利用大语言模型智能体构建的搜索流水线对已知最优汤姆逊问题构型的认证改进
translated_abstract: 汤姆逊问题要求在球面上放置N个单位电荷并使其库仑能量最小；对于较大的N，已知的最优构型收录于剑桥团簇数据库，其中最大N的条目于2026年10月确定。我们报告了N = 912、1382和2502的构型，其能量分别低于数据库值0.0036186、0.0109730和0.0614033，并通过精确整数运算进行了认证。这三种构型在模旋转意义下均为数值上严格的局部极小值，且保持了数据库构型的缺陷清单与疤痕组成；数据库中N = 912的数值此前曾由两种不同方法独立得到。我们的搜索从数据库构型出发，运行无约束的副本交换盆地跳跃算法，并结合共享极小值池、按几何重新标记后对改进区域的重组以及仅基于梯度的精修；仅凭副本交换盆地跳跃就找到了N = 912和1382的构型，前者是在五次运行之一中发现的。我们构建了
tldr: 研究者借助大语言模型智能体构建的搜索流水线（核心为副本交换盆地跳跃等方法），发现了N=912、1382和2502的汤姆逊问题新构型，其能量均低于剑桥团簇数据库的最优记录，并通过精确整数运算获得认证。
en_tdlr: Using a search pipeline built with large language model agents, the authors found certified Thomson-problem configurations for N = 912, 1382 and 2502 with energies below the best-known values in the Cambridge Cluster Database.
